fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Content card: title and description. The eyebrow and the CTA button come from the fields below.

fields.name: classes_eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: Dynamic shows the name of the Link's parent page and links to it. Static uses the Eyebrow text and Eyebrow link below.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Eyebrow text
fields.description: Leave blank to show the name of the Eyebrow link page.

fields.name: topicLink
fields.label: Eyebrow link
fields.description: Page the eyebrow links to. Leave blank to use the parent page of Link.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Page the CTA button links to. With a Dynamic eyebrow, the eyebrow links to this page's parent.

fields.name: ctaLinkText
fields.label: CTA text
fields.description: CTA button text. Leave blank to show "Read more".

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Presentation
fields.description: Optional modifiers. Full width removes the rounded container; alignment controls which side the content card sits on.
